note: DE 101.103.54800 maps from the DE study's rounds EC to CJ that no other DE fixture holds, saved in the scenario editor (Team Positions ticked unless teamPositions is false) and read back with AoE2ScenarioParser 0.9.4. Each map names its probe script in tools/scenario-probe/de-study/probes. size is the saved map's side and lobbySize the editor lobby's, when an override_map_size made them differ. Grids are row-major 'value*count' runs, layer -1 is no layer, cliffs are [object id, x, y, facing]. A map with 'known' is one the preview does not match yet, for the reason given. Frozen measured data, added to with tools/scenario-probe/export_de_fixture.py.
